content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for OAV Pichukuli Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: www.khordha.odisha.gov.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 21-08-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the OAV Pichukuli Supporting Staff recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the Supporting Staff posts at OAV Pichukuli is 21-08-2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address before this date.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Supporting Staff posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 6 vacancies for Supporting Staff posts at Odisha Adarsha Vidyalaya Pichukuli. These include positions like Warden, Chowkidar-cum-Sweeper, Head Cook, and Assistant Cook.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for the OAV Pichukuli Supporting Staff recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the application form and send it to the official address mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q4. What are the educational qualifications required for the posts?
faq.answer: The educational qualifications vary by post. For Warden, a B.A/B.Sc. degree is required. For Chowkidar-cum-Sweeper, HSC is the minimum qualification. Specific qualifications for Head Cook and Assistant Cook should be checked in the official notification.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for the OAV Pichukuli Supporting Staff posts?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the OAV Pichukuli Supporting Staff recruitment. All candidates can apply without paying any fee.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for these positions?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Supporting Staff posts includes Document Verification, Interview, a Practical Cooking Test (for cook positions), and finally, the preparation of a Merit List.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary structure for the Supporting Staff posts?
faq.answer: The salaries vary for each post: Warden will receive Rs. 21,175/-, Chowkidar-cum-Sweeper Rs. 7500/-, Head Cook Rs. 9000/-, and Assistant Cook Rs. 6750/-.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I download the application form?
faq.answer: The application form can be downloaded from the official website of the organization, which is www.khordha.odisha.gov.in. Ensure you download the correct form from the official source.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should I attach with the application form?
faq.answer: You should attach self-attested copies of required documents, including your photograph, signature, ID proof, and relevant educational and experience certificates as specified in the official notification.

faq.answer: The official website for Odisha Adarsha Vidyalaya Pichukuli is www.khordha.odisha.gov.in. This is where you can find the official notification and download the application form.
